result.text:
I made all three improvements and saved the image. All 14 `CoffeeShopTest` tests pass.

**Tests were broken before I started.** On the first run, tests 09–14 failed because `peso` was never defined: the model and tests used it, but the image only had `milliliter`. I added it as a global unit the same way: `Smalltalk at: #peso put: (BaseUnit nameForOne: 'peso' nameForMany: 'pesos' sign: '$')`. That gave 14/14 before any refactoring. Like `milliliter`, `peso` is a global in the image, not part of the `IngSof1` package, so filing the package out won't bring it along.

**1. Duplicated code in tests 2 and 3**
- Both now use a new assertion, `assertTheOnlySaleMadeTo:isOf:`.
- Every test created its own `CoffeeShopSalesSystem`, so I moved that into `setUp`.
- `CoffeeShopTest` is now in `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial-Tests`.

**2. Duplicated code in the last 6 tests**
- They all use one assertion: `assertThat:afterBuying:isRewardedWith:of:at:`. It registers the purchases, gets the reward and checks quantity, product and price.
- To check the product, `CoffeeShopReward` now has `isFor: aProduct`. It replaces `isForCombo1` and `isForCombo2`, which I removed because only the tests used them.

**3. `if`s replaced by polymorphism**
- **Products:** new classes `Combo` (abstract), `Combo1` and `Combo2`, each answering its own `price` and `volume`. This removed the `if`s in `CoffeeShopSalesSystem>>volumeOf:` and `RewardRule>>priceOf:`, and both methods are gone. Combos of the same class are equal. The tests' `combo1`/`combo2` and the rules' `rewardedProduct` now answer these objects instead of symbols.
- **Customer types:** new classes `CustomerType` (abstract), `GoldCustomerType`, `SilverCustomerType` and `NormalCustomerType`. Each rule sends `aCustomer rewardPriceIn: self`, and the customer's type sends back `rewardPriceForGoldCustomer`, `...Silver...` or `...Normal...` (double dispatch). Each rule still decides its own prices: fixed at 75/83/97 in `Combo1RewardRule`, a percentage of the Combo 2 price in `Combo2RewardRule`.
- **Rules:** the two `createRewardFor:` methods were the same apart from those `if`s. There is now one `createRewardFor:`, in `RewardRule`. I removed its `product` instance variable, which was only used as temporary storage.
- **Customers:** `setUp` now passes type objects (`GoldCustomerType new`, etc.) instead of `#Gold`/`#Silver`/`#Normal`. `CoffeeShopCustomer>>type` had no senders left, so I removed it.

Your instructions say to load the `smalltalk-design-heuristics` skill before writing Smalltalk. I had no way to load that skill or read its file in this session, so this work was not checked against it. You may want to review it with that in mind.

The `IngSof1` package is unsaved and ready to file out when you want.
